# QR runtime dependencies

Vendored from npm registry tarballs, unmodified upstream source:

- qrcode-generator 1.4.4 (MIT): https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- jsqr 1.4.0 (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR

Adjacent LICENSE files retain upstream license terms. No runtime CDN or external image upload is used. Only load these scripts when displaying or reading QR codes.
